hebrewText: וְ/הִנֵּ֨ה גַם צָד֜וֹק וְ/כָֽל הַ/לְוִיִּ֣ם אִתּ֗/וֹ נֹֽשְׂאִים֙ אֶת אֲרוֹן֙ בְּרִ֣ית הָ/אֱלֹהִ֔ים וַ/יַּצִּ֨קוּ֙ אֶת אֲר֣וֹן הָ/אֱלֹהִ֔ים וַ/יַּ֖עַל אֶבְיָתָ֑ר עַד תֹּ֥ם כָּל הָ/עָ֖ם לַ/עֲב֥וֹר מִן הָ/עִֽיר

tokens.bdb: lo!
tokens.kjv: behold, lo, see.
tokens.explanation: hinneh — interjeição de atenção: eis, veja, olha!

tokens.bdb: properly, assemblage; used only adverbially also, even, yea, though; often repeated as correl. both...and
tokens.kjv: again, alike, also, (so much) as (soon), both (so)...and, but, either...or, even, for all, (in) likewise (manner), moreover, nay...neither, one, then(-refore), though, what, with, yea.

tokens.bdb: Tsadok, the name of eight or nine Israelites
tokens.kjv: Zadok.

tokens.bdb: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
tokens.kjv: (in) all (manner, (ye)), altogether, any (manner), enough, every (one, place, thing), howsoever, as many as, (no-) thing, ought, whatsoever, (the) whole, whoso(-ever).
tokens.explanation: kol — todo, toda, qualquer, totalidade de algo

tokens.bdb: a Levite or descendant of Levi
tokens.kjv: Leviite.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a Levite or descendant of Levi
tokens.enLiteralWord: a Levite or descendant of Levi
tokens.explanation: a Levite or descendant of Levi
tokens.explanationEn: a Levite or descendant of Levi

tokens.bdb: properly, nearness (used only as a preposition or an adverb), near; hence, generally, with, by, at, among, etc.
tokens.kjv: against, among, before, by, for, from, in(-to), (out) of, with. Often with another prepositional prefix.

tokens.bdb: to lift, in a great variety of applications, literal and figurative, absolute and relative
tokens.kjv: accept, advance, arise, (able to, (armor), suffer to) bear(-er, up), bring (forth), burn, carry (away), cast, contain, desire, ease, exact, exalt (self), extol, fetch, forgive, furnish, further, give, go on, help, high, hold up, honorable ([phrase] man), lade, lay, lift (self) up, lofty, marry, magnify, [idiom] needs, obtain, pardon, raise (up), receive, regard, respect, set (up), spare, stir up, [phrase] swear, take (away, up), [idiom] utterly, wear, yield.

tokens.bdb: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
tokens.kjv: (as such unrepresented in English).
tokens.explanation: et — partícula de objeto direto, sem tradução literal em português

tokens.bdb: a box
tokens.kjv: ark, chest, coffin.

tokens.bdb: a compact (because made by passing between pieces of flesh)
tokens.kjv: confederacy, (con-) feder(-ate), covenant, league.

tokens.bdb: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus, especially with the article) of the supreme God; occasionally applied by way of deference to magistrates; and sometimes as a superlative
tokens.kjv: angels, [idiom] exceeding, God (gods) (-dess, -ly), [idiom] (very) great, judges, [idiom] mighty.
tokens.enLiteralWord: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus
tokens.explanation: Elohim — nome hebraico de Deus. Plural de majestade. Denota o único Deus verdadeiro
tokens.explanationEn: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus

tokens.bdb: properly, to pour out (transitive or intransitive); by implication, to melt or cast as metal; by extension, to place firmly, to stiffen or grow hard
tokens.kjv: cast, cleave fast, be (as) firm, grow, be hard, lay out, molten, overflow, pour (out), run out, set down, stedfast.

tokens.bdb: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
tokens.kjv: (as such unrepresented in English).
tokens.explanation: et — partícula de objeto direto, sem tradução literal em português

tokens.bdb: a box
tokens.kjv: ark, chest, coffin.

tokens.bdb: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus, especially with the article) of the supreme God; occasionally applied by way of deference to magistrates; and sometimes as a superlative
tokens.kjv: angels, [idiom] exceeding, God (gods) (-dess, -ly), [idiom] (very) great, judges, [idiom] mighty.
tokens.enLiteralWord: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus
tokens.explanation: Elohim — nome hebraico de Deus. Plural de majestade. Denota o único Deus verdadeiro
tokens.explanationEn: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus

tokens.bdb: to ascend, intransitively (be high) or actively (mount); used in a great variety of senses, primary and secondary, literal and figurative
tokens.kjv: arise (up), (cause to) ascend up, at once, break (the day) (up), bring (up), (cause to) burn, carry up, cast up, [phrase] shew, climb (up), (cause to, make to) come (up), cut off, dawn, depart, exalt, excel, fall, fetch up, get up, (make to) go (away, up); grow (over) increase, lay, leap, levy, lift (self) up, light, (make) up, [idiom] mention, mount up, offer, make to pay, [phrase] perfect, prefer, put (on), raise, recover, restore, (make to) rise (up), scale, set (up), shoot forth (up), (begin to) spring (up), stir up, take away (up), work.

tokens.bdb: Ebjathar, an Israelite
tokens.kjv: Abiathar.

tokens.bdb: as far (or long, or much) as, whether of space (even unto) or time (during, while, until) or degree (equally with)
tokens.kjv: against, and, as, at, before, by (that), even (to), for(-asmuch as), (hither-) to, [phrase] how long, into, as long (much) as, (so) that, till, toward, until, when, while, ([phrase] as) yet.

tokens.bdb: to complete, in a good or a bad sense, literal, or figurative, transitive or intransitive
tokens.kjv: accomplish, cease, be clean (pass-) ed, consume, have done, (come to an, have an, make an) end, fail, come to the full, be all gone, [idiom] be all here, be (make) perfect, be spent, sum, be (shew self) upright, be wasted, whole.

tokens.bdb: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
tokens.kjv: (in) all (manner, (ye)), altogether, any (manner), enough, every (one, place, thing), howsoever, as many as, (no-) thing, ought, whatsoever, (the) whole, whoso(-ever).
tokens.explanation: kol — todo, toda, qualquer, totalidade de algo

tokens.bdb: a people (as a congregated unit); specifically, a tribe (as those of Israel); hence (collectively) troops or attendants; figuratively, a flock
tokens.kjv: folk, men, nation, people.
tokens.explanation: am — povo, nação, grupo de pessoas com identidade comum

tokens.bdb: to cross over; used very widely of any transition (literal or figurative; transitive, intransitive, intensive, causative); specifically, to cover (in copulation)
tokens.kjv: alienate, alter, [idiom] at all, beyond, bring (over, through), carry over, (over-) come (on, over), conduct (over), convey over, current, deliver, do away, enter, escape, fail, gender, get over, (make) go (away, beyond, by, forth, his way, in, on, over, through), have away (more), lay, meddle, overrun, make partition, (cause to, give, make to, over) pass(-age, along, away, beyond, by, -enger, on, out, over, through), (cause to, make) [phrase] proclaim(-amation), perish, provoke to anger, put away, rage, [phrase] raiser of taxes, remove, send over, set apart, [phrase] shave, cause to (make) sound, [idiom] speedily, [idiom] sweet smelling, take (away), (make to) transgress(-or), translate, turn away, (way-) faring man, be wrath.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: to cross over; used very widely of any transition (literal or figurative; transitive
tokens.enLiteralWord: to cross over; used very widely of any transition (literal or figurative; transitive
tokens.explanation: to cross over; used very widely of any transition (literal or figurative; transitive
tokens.explanationEn: to cross over; used very widely of any transition (literal or figurative; transitive

tokens.bdb: properly, a part of; hence (prepositionally), from or out of in many senses
tokens.kjv: above, after, among, at, because of, by (reason of), from (among), in, [idiom] neither, [idiom] nor, (out) of, over, since, [idiom] then, through, [idiom] whether, with.

tokens.bdb: a city (a place guarded by waking or a watch) in the widest sense (even of a mere encampment or post)
tokens.kjv: Ai (from margin), city, court (from margin), town.
tokens.enLiteralWord: a city  in the widest sense
tokens.explanationEn: a city  in the widest sense
